cross_cutting_nfrs.name: SM&CR Review Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: SmscrReview records retained for minimum 7 years. Required for FCA enforcement proceedings and SR period.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: FCA enforcement limitation period for conduct rule breaches.

regulatory_slas.name: FCA SMCR — Conduct Rule Breach Notification
regulatory_slas.requirement: Banks must notify the FCA of conduct rule breaches by SMF holders as soon as practicable and no later than 7 business days of becoming aware.
regulatory_slas.source: FCA SYSC 22.7 (regulatory references); FCA SUP 15.3 (notification requirements)
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement; personal liability for SMF holder; potential prohibition order
